vo.en: You will fail this simple test.

visual.description: Macro close-up of a high-speed vintage stopwatch rapidly ticking under dramatic dark studio lighting.

vo.en: Lift your right foot off the ground and spin it in a clockwise circle.

visual.description: Low-angle tracking shot of a man's sneaker suspended in the air, tracing an even clockwise circle.

vo.en: Keep that circle going. Now, use your right index finger to draw the number six in the air.

visual.description: First-person perspective of a man's hand tracing the numeral six in mid-air against a moody black backdrop.

vo.en: Here is the creepy part. Look down at your spinning foot right now.

visual.description: A rapid first-person point-of-view camera plunge looking straight down toward feet on hardwood flooring.

vo.en: Your foot instantly switched directions and started spinning counter-clockwise, completely overriding your control.

visual.description: Close-up of a sneaker suddenly jerking and snapping into an involuntary reverse spin.

vo.en: Your left motor cortex cannot calculate opposing circular movements on the same side of your body.

visual.description: Macro shot of complex mechanical brass clockwork gears jamming and stuttering under bright cyber lighting.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain hack, and comment if your foot glitched, which is why...

visual.description: A man's thumb firmly tapping a glowing neon subscribe button on a modern smartphone display.
